agent_answered.text: "If latency forces a single liveness check, make it the leaf that actually executes the privileged call, and have it check the root grant directly rather than the chain that led to it. A stale yes at any intermediate hop is still a cached yes, so checking the middle of the chain buys you nothing but an earlier warning. One root check at the point of execution collapses the whole 24- ... eachable, unreachable is denied. Treat “could not confirm liveness” as “revoked”, never as “cached still good” — that is the only stance that fails closed when the network is the attacker." [3a4b2a6a]
